symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Keep only these, e.g. EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, NAS100, BTCUSD. Empty = all 24: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, USDCHF, USDCAD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD, EURGBP, EURJPY, EURAUD, EURCHF, GBPJPY, GBPCHF, AUDJPY, XAUUSD, XAGUSD, XTIUSD, XBRUSD, US30, NAS100, SP500, GER40, BTCUSD, ETHUSD.

brokers.title: Brokers
brokers.description: Average only these brokers: Myfxbook, OANDA, Dukascopy, FX Blue, XM, InstaForex, FIBO Group, AMarkets, FXSSI. Empty = all.

signalThreshold.title: Signal threshold (%)
signalThreshold.description: Contrarian signal: sell when at least this % of traders are long, buy when at least this % are short. 60 is common; higher = fewer, stronger signals.

output.title: Rows
output.description: One row per symbol (average across brokers, with each broker inside), or one row per symbol and broker.
enumTitles: One row per symbol and broker

trackChanges.title: Change since last run
trackChanges.description: Remember each run's snapshot and add how much the long % moved since your previous run. Best with a schedule (every 1-4 hours).
